name: Craftsman's Writ: Red Whelp Gloves
summary: A transferable writ requests one pair of Red Whelp Gloves. It names a delivery place and payment for the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A faded note requests one pair of Red Whelp Gloves and gives a delivery location and payment. You need to hold the writ to complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one pair of Red Whelp Gloves.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the gloves?
faq.answer: The writ provides a delivery location marked on your map.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: You need the writ in your possession to complete the exchange.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.
Yes. The writ includes information about payment.
